title: Common contract definitions (Tier 1 standards, ADR-006 / docs/STANDARDS.md)

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code. Amounts are numbers; formatting is the renderer's job.

localeTag.description: BCP 47 locale tag (already used by VariantKey.locale).

money.description: Integer cents or round-at-boundary decimal; formatting is the renderer's job (CLAUDE.md).

amount.description: Minor units (cents). Never a floating-point major-unit amount.

unitOfMeasure.description: UNECE Recommendation 20 unit-of-measure code. Our own reference data previously used pcs/jar/sht — those are display names, not codes; this Stage 1 task fixes the contract side. There is no in-repo reference-data generator to fix (spike/ was deleted at Stage 0 close, see docs/RESULTS.md) — any future seeded reference data must emit codes from this enum, not the old ad hoc strings.

partyIdentification.description: Reserved ISO 6523 / Peppol EAS party-identification fields (ADR-006 Tier 1: reserved now so Tier 3 e-invoicing doesn't reshape the contract). Optional until a Tier 3 trigger fires.

scheme.description: ISO 6523 ICD or Peppol EAS scheme identifier, e.g. "0195" (UEN) or "0088" (GLN).
